Interpretation: They want to compute the logarithm of the distance (which was 980 miles earlier) with base equal to the previous fuel value? Wait: "將距離的對數以先前燃料值為底，計算精度為10。使用20為底。" That seems contradictory: "以先前燃料值為底" means base is previous fuel value. But then "使用20為底" says use 20 as base. Maybe they want to compute log(distance) with base 20, but also maybe they want to compute log(distance) with base previous fuel value?
